year_arcs.2020: Founded and built a minimal viable product, hiring a core team of 5 engineers and securing first pilot with a regional carrier.
year_arcs.2021: Launched Helix API, experienced a near-miss outage during a high-volume shipment surge, prompting a shift to a microservices architecture.
year_arcs.2022: Secured Series A funding, expanded to 30 employees, and introduced Helix Dashboard, while a strategic pivot moved focus from B2C to mid-market freight forwarders.
year_arcs.2023: Faced a critical customer escalation that led to a product redesign, followed by a 15 % layoff to streamline operations and a leadership change with a new COO.
year_arcs.2024: Released Helix AI Optimizer, achieved 20 % cost savings for flagship clients, and onboarded 10 new enterprise customers.
year_arcs.2025: Implemented a company-wide documentation overhaul, doubling internal wiki usage, and celebrated 85 employees with a global virtual summit.
year_arcs.2026: Planned a Series B round, integrated AI-driven predictive analytics into the platform, and announced a strategic partnership with a major logistics consortium.

eras.name: Bootstrap Beginnings
eras.characterisation: Documentation was informal, limited to README files and a handful of Slack threads; the team relied on verbal knowledge transfer and ad-hoc notes.

eras.name: Structured Foundations
eras.characterisation: The company introduced a shared Notion workspace, formalized API specs, and began maintaining a public-facing product roadmap; documentation grew from 5 pages to 30.

eras.name: Enterprise-grade Documentation
eras.characterisation: A dedicated technical writer was hired, a style guide enforced, and all internal and external docs were migrated to Confluence; the team adopted versioned documentation with automated linting.

eras.name: Agile Documentation
eras.characterisation: Documentation became tightly coupled with sprint cycles, with daily stand-up notes captured in Confluence and a lightweight wiki for quick updates; the focus shifted to just-in-time docs.

eras.name: Knowledge-centric Culture
eras.characterisation: The company built a knowledge graph linking product docs, support tickets, and code repositories; documentation was treated as a first-class product, with quarterly reviews and a dedicated docs-as-code pipeline.

products: **Helix API** (2021): A RESTful interface that exposes real-time shipment data and routing analytics to partner systems.
**Helix Dashboard** (2022): A web portal that visualizes freight metrics, carrier performance, and cost breakdowns for mid-market forwarders.
**Helix AI Optimizer** (2024): An AI-driven recommendation engine that suggests optimal routing, carrier selection, and load consolidation to reduce costs.
